summary: On 26 March 2026, CISO Farhan Sheikh emailed Rahul Verma indicating that the promised SOC2 Type II report had not been received. He stated that without the report he cannot start the vendor risk assessment and that the internal committee meets on 9 April. He also requested data residency details, emphasizing that settlement data must remain in India. The deal is stalled pending delivery of the security documentation.
